reading_note: The arc traces how the natural man comes into being from the corruption of higher truths and is then redeemed. Falsities from evil (the Watchers) descended from the heavens of the mind into the natural plane, were bound, and their offspring (the abortions = ill-formed thoughts) became the substance from which the natural mind of Adam was constituted. Divine truth (Jesus) saw the prayer of the Five interior degrees and clothed Himself with this material in order to cast down the disorderly affections, opening the obstructed channels of perception, breath, and love so that the lower supports of the Grand Man could rise. The teaching then turns inward: the same drama recurs cyclically in every regenerating person — sin rooted in the body with the Old Man, until the Mind of Light humbles it. Finally it answers how the great Strong One (divine truth) can wear the small body of flesh: by the same correspondential law by which every spiritual power is fixed like a tree in its appointed place in the cosmos.
